parameters.implementation_policy: Preserve each route implementation, shape and chunk strategy. Include intrinsic costs; do not normalize by bytes or request counts.
parameters.audit_profile: summary_exports_only; full runtime lane and byte checks retained and counted
parameters.primary_time_source: same-process CPU monotonic ns, with actual GPU consumer completion observed on CPU
parameters.warmup_policy: First measured call reported separately; 5 repeated calls except output.weight has 1. No empty-cache or steady-state claim.
parameters.resource_root_policy: E:/v1_update; full original guard; explicit --resource-root {resource_root} when directly invoking old V3 runner

budgets.shared_model_and_input_cas: separate; not in 2 GiB output cap
budgets.stop_policy: stop and retain all attempts at any cap; no truncation, silent sample replacement, implicit matrix reduction or budget growth

retention.main_runs: scalar summaries plus all required references; no lane/request/activity/chunk raw files by default
retention.cleanup: After scientific acceptance, committed B and complete verify: disclose exact scope and size, ask user. Explicit per-experiment approval required; commit exact retention plan before any deletion; commit results and anchors; verify --retained. No automatic deletion.
retention.current_experiment_cleanup: User explicitly declined cleanup; retain all logs for this experiment.

budget_revision.interpretation: Budget caps, not measured duration. Weight matrix and process repeats unchanged; model matrix access work halves, total wall does not necessarily halve. Pilot required before formal.

user_authorization.instruction: 不清理了，启动正式测试，完成后报告结果
user_authorization.reallocation: 15 minute reserve transferred to formal stage; scientific thresholds and counts unchanged
user_authorization.cleanup: declined; retain all existing and current experiment logs

acceptance.weight_outputs: Every call vs same native reference, element/bit identity; borrowed weights unchanged; full coverage and drain checks.
acceptance.model_outputs: Same token sequence, all 4 full logits and native KV content/version/lifecycle as same-condition native reference.
acceptance.resource_and_protocol: Original guards, thresholds, timeouts, dependency, coverage and audit drain criteria remain strict.
acceptance.statistics: Per-process repeated mean, median/min/max of 3 independent processes; all individual values retained; no p95 or significance claims.
acceptance.identity: Own candidate source/build identity and validator; immutable historical manifests/validators.
acceptance.delivery: Future scientific runs require report B committed and verify report_committed=true. Plan P alone is not scientific acceptance.
